author: zhenghp1
quote: I genuinely cannot believe this is what we waited 13 years for. From any other developer, this would be a good game—but this is Rockstar, and this is supposed to be Grand Theft Auto. The unanimous 99 Metascore proves critics got blinded by spectacle while ignoring how much fun was stripped out.Narratively, the whole duo setup feels like childishly playing house. Jason is painfully boring with a completely redundant role; they should have just made Lucia the sole protagonist and left Jason as a side character.Mechanically, Rockstar tried to treat cars like RDR2 horses—keeping every restriction without any of the convenience. You deal with fuel limits, fragile cars that break down after a few hits, slow carjacking, and police tracking just for stealing a ride off the street. Heavy guns are locked in your trunk, yet you can't whistle for your car, and it gets destroyed instantly in firefights. Even classic street chaos like provoking NPC brawls is ruined by rigid AI that blames the player for everything. Once the credits roll, free roam feels like a chore rather than a sandbox.
